fields.name: source port
fields.description: optional field; if not used, a value of zero is inserted.

fields.name: destination port
fields.description: destination port has a meaning within the context of a particular internet destination address.

fields.name: length
fields.description: length in octets of this user datagram including this header and the data. minimum value of the length is eight.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of a pseudo header of information from the ip header, the udp header, and the data, padded with zero octets at the end (if necessary) to make a multiple of two octets.
